name: bluestep-one
description: Build BlueStep One components on Claude Code: set up a component workspace, then build, publish and check a component one gate at a time (fresh types, type check and tests, copies, required fields, draft push, build and publish from a signed-in tab, served-sha, UX and design checks), with an on-demand BlueStep One reference and a tab guard for browser GraphQL calls. Needs bluestep-tools.
